stopConditions.condition: .env.xnp-review-account or XNP_REVIEW_RECOVERY_KEY is missing on the operator machine
stopConditions.stop: Do not fill App Review Information Sign-In Information.
stopConditions.recovery: Regenerate the review account privately, update 11-test-account-redacted.json without secrets, and rerun gates.

stopConditions.condition: 11-test-account-redacted.json is missing, containsSecret is not false, or it contains secret/token/password/code fields
stopConditions.stop: Do not paste any credential into App Store Connect.
stopConditions.recovery: Regenerate redacted proof and rerun check_app_store_connect_materials.py plus check_app_store_evidence.py --allow-incomplete.

stopConditions.condition: recoveryVerified or syncSeeded is not true
stopConditions.recovery: Verify the recovery key login and seed fictional sync data before retrying.

stopConditions.condition: RD-13 phone test account is requested before real SMS provider screenshot and live-send proof exist
stopConditions.stop: Keep phone test account marked pending.
stopConditions.recovery: Complete 07-sms-provider evidence and SMS live-send proof first.

stopConditions.condition: RD-14 WeChat test account is requested before real WeChat Open Platform evidence and Release bundle proof exist
stopConditions.stop: Keep WeChat test account marked pending.
stopConditions.recovery: Complete 08-wechat-open-platform evidence, Release wx URL Scheme, Universal Link, server AppSecret proof, and RD-14.

stopConditions.condition: RD-10/RD-13/RD-14/RD-15 screenshot or recording shows recovery key, code, complete phone number, token, AppSecret, object key, or real baby photo
stopConditions.stop: Do not archive the leaked media as App Store evidence.
stopConditions.recovery: Retake and redact the evidence from the same iOS 26.5 TestFlight or signed build.

stopConditions.condition: RD-15 does not prove account deletion, old token invalidation, and sync/photo deletion boundary
stopConditions.stop: Do not claim account deletion evidence complete.
stopConditions.recovery: Rerun account deletion and backend deletion proof before App Store submission.

stopConditions.condition: RD evidence is not from iOS 26.5 TestFlight or Xcode signed real-device build
stopConditions.stop: Do not use simulator, iOS 27, or another build as real-device proof.
stopConditions.recovery: Use an available iOS 26.5 physical iPhone and the same build selected for TestFlight/App Store Connect.
Finish production proof, provider proof, storage proof, App Store evidence, and iOS gates.
Archive real App Store, provider, TestFlight, final screenshot, and iOS 26.5 real-device evidence.

completionRule: review-test-account-packet-not-evidence; not submission permission; this packet only defines how to fill App Review private Sign-In Information and collect account-login/account-deletion evidence. It does not prove App Review Information has been filled, does not store the recovery key, does not prove phone or WeChat login, does not replace iOS 26.5 real-device regression, and cannot authorize Submit for Review until app-store-evidence.json ready=true, production-readiness.json ready=true, and launch-objective-audit.json ready=true.
